name: Will painted cabinets last, and how do I maintain them?
description: Properly painted cabinets can last 5-10+ years. Maintain them with regular cleaning using a mild, non-abrasive cleaner and avoid harsh chemicals.

mainEntity.name: Will painted cabinets last, and how do I maintain them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly painted cabinets, using high-quality materials and professional application techniques, can last for many years, often 5-10 years or more before needing touch-ups. To maintain them, regular cleaning with a soft cloth and a mild, non-abrasive cleaner is recommended. Avoid harsh chemicals, excessive moisture, and abrasive scrubbers which can damage the finish. Promptly wipe away spills and grease to preserve the paint's integrity and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Properly painted cabinets can last 5-10+ years. Maintain them with regular cleaning using a mild, non-abrasive cleaner and avoid harsh chemicals.
